plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Human Development and Family Studies, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/human-development-family-studies-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Human Development and Family Studies Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as footnote number(s) with units do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number(s) preserved in choice_note; the catalog's grid legend groups footnotes 5 and 6 under 'See program recommendations or requirements'; see advisor. Footnote 1: students placing directly into ENG 102/114 need an additional 3 units of electives. Students must maintain a 2.0 GPA and earn a C or better in each degree and elective requirement. The HDFS practicum (HDFS 231) may require fingerprints, background check, and/or TB test depending on placement. Designed to transfer to UNR's BS in HDFS. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid (the catalog notes EDU 208 requires EDU 203 as prerequisite, relevant only if chosen as an elective).
